roles.weakest_formalism: typed labelled transition system (equivalently, a directed multigraph/quiver with operation labels)
roles.preserves: state identity; source/target typing; branching; direction; multiple distinct transitions between the same endpoints; operation labels
roles.loses_or_does_not_assert: no composition law by itself; no linearity; no invertibility; no metric; no claim that every transition is deterministic
roles.first_consequence: Distinct transitions and paths can remain distinct even when they share endpoints. Passing to the path category makes histories first-class without identifying them.
roles.anti_overclaim: Do not promote the transition graph itself to a universal ontology.

roles.weakest_formalism: many-sorted partial algebra of admissible n-ary operations; use a multicategory only when composition of such n-ary operations is itself needed
roles.preserves: typed multi-input closure; explicit domain of admissibility; outputs; distinction between undefined composition and a defined composition with a particular result
roles.loses_or_does_not_assert: does not assume multiplication, commutativity, associativity, binary arity, or total closure universally
roles.first_consequence: SUN can state closure rules as partial operations c:D⊆X1×…×Xn→Y. This cleanly separates 'not an admissible composition' from 'admissible and evaluates to y'.
roles.anti_overclaim: Multiplication in the music realization is one implementation of C, not the carrier-independent definition.

roles.weakest_formalism: invariant map / conserved observable on the subcollection of transformations claimed to preserve it
roles.preserves: the declared aggregate or relation; level sets/fibers of equal invariant value; distinction between preserved aggregate and changed internal allocation
roles.loses_or_does_not_assert: does not identify states inside one invariant fiber; does not say which transformations ought to preserve I
roles.first_consequence: If I∘f=I and I∘g=I wherever defined, then I∘(g∘f)=I wherever the composite is defined. Invariance is closed under lawful composition.
roles.anti_overclaim: An invariant does not determine the mechanism that preserves it.

roles.weakest_formalism: typed admissibility predicate or constraint relation K(R,q)∈{0,1} on a representation R relative to a requirement q
roles.fit: EXACT for the earned conditional claim
roles.preserves: separation of numerical/algebraic validity from structural admissibility; explicit scope of the current representation class
roles.loses_or_does_not_assert: does not choose a repair; does not imply minimality; does not guarantee that a richer representation exists
roles.first_consequence: A state/transition may satisfy the numerical equations while failing K. Therefore numerical success is not sufficient for representational admissibility.
roles.anti_overclaim: K=0 licenses 'current representation insufficient'; it does not license any specific lift.

roles.weakest_formalism: state-space extension/refinement with lifted dynamics and a commuting projection (semiconjugate extension); covering/fibration only as special cases
roles.fit: EXACT at the abstract level; COVERING/FIBRATION = PARTIAL/SPECIAL
roles.preserves: the old observable behavior through projection while allowing extra hidden state/history coordinates
roles.loses_or_does_not_assert: does not require local triviality, topology, deck groups, minimal dimension, unique lift, or a particular hidden coordinate
roles.first_consequence: For π∘T~=T∘π, every lifted trajectory projects to a valid base trajectory. Different lifted trajectories may project to the same observable trajectory.
roles.anti_overclaim: Do not promote FK monodromy or any specific covering-space model into L.

roles.weakest_formalism: observation map π:X~→Y together with its kernel equivalence x~πy iff π(x)=π(y)
roles.preserves: the exposed/realized value and whatever structure is explicitly required of π
roles.loses_or_does_not_assert: all distinctions inside a fiber unless separately encoded; no homomorphism/functor claim unless verified per carrier
roles.first_consequence: Every map factors through the quotient X~/~π onto im(π). Thus π(x)=π(y) implies observational equivalence, not state identity; identity follows only if π is injective.
roles.anti_overclaim: The quotient is set-theoretic by default; algebraic/topological quotient structure must be earned separately.

non_promotions: single formalism subsuming all six roles
